decided: 2026-09-28, per docs/paper-s25-respec-cascade-rerun-protocol-v1-amendment-1.md (AD-1, AD-3, section 5). Revives the v1 D=8 design (docs/paper-s25-respec-cascade-rerun-protocol-v1.md section 1.3, manifests/s25-respec-documents-locked.json) minus masters-dissertation-defense -- AD-1: the dissertation defense copy is unpublished, self-authored committee-defense material, not representative of the target population a confirmatory claim generalizes to; AD-3: it is held out of the confirmatory statistic entirely, not merely de-headlined -- plus 3 newly-vetted GOVDOCS1 (Digital Corpora) documents as a second, independent public-document sourcing pipeline (amendment section 5), addressing the same source-concentration concern at the corpus level. This manifest only assembles and locks the candidate corpus; no confirmatory trial has been run under it. Per v1 section 1.5, eligibility and anchor schedules must still be recomputed at the Meridian Docs pin (89c93fac6a9ee7a03d98baab34ba7043de983018) before any confirmatory trial -- every eligibility number below was computed with the unpinned editable install, exactly like the rest of manifests/README.md's pipeline.
selection_method: Primary list: the 2 remaining author-owned documents (v1 section 1.1; masters-dissertation-defense excluded per AD-1/AD-3) + the same 5 public docx-corpus documents already locked in v1 and v2 (unchanged records, hash rank under seed 20260925002) + the top 3 of 6 eligible GOVDOCS1 documents by the same rank_key(seed, sha256) convention (seed 20260925002 reused, not re-seeded, for outcome-blind consistency with the rest of this project's selection method). GOVDOCS1 sourcing/eligibility pipeline run for this manifest: downloaded https://digitalcorpora.s3.amazonaws.com/corpora/files/govdocs1/by_type/docx.zip (29,033,269 bytes, verified by exact byte count) to a scratch location (never committed); extracted 163 members; sniffed every member for a real ZIP archive containing a word/document.xml part -- 162 genuine OOXML .docx survived (1 non-ZIP impostor discarded, 0 corrupt, 0 zip-but-no-document.xml), 157 unique by sha256; registered all 162 survivors into manifests/docx_corpus_pool_index.json as batch 'govdocs1-batch-v1' (bytes copied to D:\MeridianData\ooxml-graph-paper\raw\docx-corpus\govdocs1-batch-v1\<sha256>.docx); ran tools/scan_fresh_docx_pool.py scoped to just the new batch (via its existing --pool/--touched-union/--out flags, since the tool's fresh set is defined by manifests/touched_union.json's fresh_indices rather than by scanning the whole pool index -- a discrepancy from the original task plan, worked around with the tool's own supported flags rather than by editing the shared touched_union.json; see notes below), then merged the result into manifests/fresh_pool_structure_pii_scan.json (162 new records: 30 plan_found, 111 pii_clean); ran tools/respec_eligibility.py fresh unmodified as a full re-run over the merged fresh pool (794 documents total, the 22 govdocs1 documents that were both plan_found and pii_clean among them); ran tools/build_rerun_candidates.py respec unmodified (its fresh branch requires >25 outline headings, kept disjoint from the K4SR 3-25 band by construction, and >=1 five-family-usable anchor-set) -- 6 of the 22 govdocs1 documents qualified, and all 6 reached the full five_family_usable==4 AND six_family_usable==4 (exceeding the >=1 five-family-usable minimum bar this task set). The top 3 of those 6 by hash rank are selected below; the other 3 equally-eligible documents (docx-corpus ids 406729, 470116, 116733; sha256 32893fd4..., a29ba233..., a823c29a...) are not selected at D=10 but remain in manifests/respec_public_candidates.json for a future larger D.

sensitivity_check_only.sanctioned_use: The ONLY sanctioned way to examine this document's data going forward is the pre-existing cluster-merge mechanism of docs/paper-s25-respec-cascade-rerun-protocol-v1.md section 6.8, item 3 ('Document-level tests with every author document merged into one cluster (D_eff = D - 2, or D - 3 with D-R2), for P1-P5'), reused for this purpose by amendment-1 section 3: if a future disclosed sensitivity check re-admits this document's chains, they are merged into the same shared author-document cluster identity already assigned to jcshm-manuscript and jcshm-si in graph_scorer.cluster_paired_sign_flip_test's document-level clustering -- never given an independent document-level cluster id, and never reported as a standalone per_document entry. Such a check is a disclosed sensitivity check only: it never substitutes for, overrides, or is averaged into the headline public_documents_only result or the secondary pooled result, and no run may report a verdict that depends on this check passing or failing (amendment-1 section 3, final paragraph).

notes: STEP-3 tooling discrepancy, disclosed rather than silently worked around: tools/scan_fresh_docx_pool.py does not scan 'the whole pool index' by default (as the originating task instructions guessed it might if it lacked batch scoping); it scans exactly the pool indices listed in manifests/touched_union.json's 'fresh_indices', which is a snapshot computed before this GOVDOCS1 batch existed. Appending the 162 new pool records to manifests/docx_corpus_pool_index.json alone would NOT have made scan_fresh_docx_pool.py see them. Resolved by using the tool's own existing --pool/--touched-union/--out flags to run it scoped to a small ad-hoc pool file containing just the 162 new records (all trivially 'fresh' -- brand new, never referenced anywhere before), then merging that output into manifests/fresh_pool_structure_pii_scan.json by hand (append + re-sort by id, matching the tool's own write_json convention exactly: indent=0, CRLF, ensure_ascii=False). manifests/touched_union.json itself was left untouched, consistent with manifests/README.md's own description of it as 'the pre-selection record' and consistent with the task's file-claim list, which did not include it.

tools/respec_eligibility.py fresh and tools/build_rerun_candidates.py respec were both run exactly as documented, with no scoping flags, over the full merged fresh pool -- their normal, unmodified behavior already covers old and new records together in one pass.
